To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 08 Mar 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: HealthWatch: QBR renewal & action queue for exec attention

Team —

Attached is the consolidated HealthWatch spreadsheet for this week’s QBR prep. Focus areas and asks below:

- Priority accounts flagged for potential renewal risk: Harbor AI (see tab), Meridian Labs, and StratusX. Harbor AI is highest-risk this week due to procurement freeze + usage drop.
- I’ve annotated usage, billing disputes, and technical incidents that could surface in the QBR. Please verify your sections and add a one-line mitigation and an owner.
- Ask for leadership: identify any request that needs executive-level involvement (credits, exception to SLA, product-commitment ask) and suggest the exact escalation wording we should use in the QBR.

Please update the sheet (healthwatch_matrix.xlsx) by EOD tomorrow. I’ll synthesize into a two-slide exec brief for the QBR and flag any immediate escalation.

Attachments: healthwatch_matrix.xlsx

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com
(415) 555-0187

---
Note: spreadsheet contains per-account score (usage/engagement/support tickets/CSAT) and a renewal confidence column (green/amber/red).

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: HealthWatch: QBR renewal & action queue for exec attention

Mina — thanks for pulling this together. Quick updates for Harbor AI (I updated the register — see attached renewal_risk_register_20270308.xlsx):

- Signal: 42% drop in token consumption MoM + two unresolved billing disputes for Feb (invoices 2217, 2231).
- Procurement: Buyer has asked for a two-week restart on approvals while they evaluate a vendor consolidation project (Procurement contact: procurement@harborai.com).
- Sales posture: Account is in negotiation for a 12-month renewal but with a reduced commit. They are asking for tighter unit pricing and a credit for perceived latency regressions last quarter.

Proposed exec asks for the QBR:
1) Offer a one-time credit equal to 10% of Feb invoice to reset relationship (need finance sign-off).
2) Commit to a roadmap check-in: schedule a technical deep-dive with our infra/product lead (R&D invitation) within two weeks.
3) Approve a short-term price protection clause for the next renewal discussion (legal to pre-clear language).

Owner/next steps: I will take ownership of the customer call (AE). Mina/Laura please confirm CS mitigation steps before I present to their leadership.

Attachment: renewal_risk_register_20270308.xlsx

Adding the CS perspective on Harbor AI:

- Health signals: multiple minor incidents in Jan/Feb (request latency spikes on long contexts), CSAT slipped from 4.6 to 4.2 after the incident but we saw recovery after a targeted patch. Usage drop looks correlated with their pilot project ending; they paused a couple of internal teams that were heavy token users.
- Open asks we can own: immediate technical remediation notes and a reminder of best-practices for batching & caching (I can put a one-page ops checklist in the packet).
- Mitigation proposal (short): 1) 1:1 technical workshop (R&D + CS) next week; 2) temporary usage credits to smooth renewal discussions; 3) dedicated monitoring dashboard access for their SREs.

I uploaded a short mitigation plan (mitigation_plan.pdf) and put my recommended owner assignments in the sheet under "CS recommendations".

Please also escalate legal input on price protection and finance on the credit. If leadership thinks a credit + workshop is the right posture, we should present that as a single package in the QBR.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Director, Customer Success, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com
